name: Isaac Galland
role: Land seller at Commerce and in Iowa
dateNote: He sold land to the Saints in 1839 and was baptized on 3 July 1839; section 124 is dated 19 January 1841.
importance: Isaac Galland was a doctor and land speculator on both sides of the Mississippi. In 1839 he sold the Saints land at Commerce and about 19,000 acres in Iowa’s Half-Breed Tract, and Joseph Smith baptized him that July. Section 124 says the Lord loves him for his work, tells him to buy Nauvoo House stock, and sends him with Hyrum Smith. He acted as a Church land agent but withdrew about 1842.
connections: Section 124 names William Marks to ordain him and Hyrum Smith as his companion.

sources.title: Isaac Galland, Joseph Smith Papers biography

reviewNote: Dates and land sales checked on JSP; death 27 Sept. 1858 read from a cut fragment. Disputes over the Iowa land titles are not covered by the JSP summary and are left out.
